voice: Preserve Steve's direct dockworker recollections while removing an anachronistic ship name and a dismissive description of Tut Smith.

entries.text: The nameplate identifies the impressive vessel as a transatlantic steamship.

Mr. Carrington arrived on a steamship from England. I remember because he had the heaviest steamer trunk I've ever lifted, and it smelled strange. Gave me a big tip, too. Then a rich lady collected him in a taxi. He called her the Countess Waldorf-Carlton.
I also remember an Egyptian gentleman in a fez who kept arguing with Dr. Carter. I think his name was Tut.
